name: sreekar2403-hive
description: Multi-agent orchestration framework that routes prompts to twelve AI CLI harnesses (opencode, Claude Code, codex, gemini, cursor-agent, pi, and more) with LLM-driven routing, retry loops, and a runtime permission gate. TypeScript/Express REST API + Vite/React 19 client (Tailwind 4, Pixi.js) in Electron.
